svg.title: coderprint: 858k new lines written, all time
svg.desc: 857,638 new lines written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 1,992 commits across all branches, 40 active days, a longest streak of 21 days, a current streak of 21 days, and 13 languages written. They came in 3 bursts of 47k, 194k and 616k lines. Share of new lines by language: Rust 50%, Python 21%, TypeScript 9%, Markdown 9%, JavaScript 6%, TeX 3%, HTML 1%, other languages 1%.
